mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, it is a clear 64 degrees at Badger Prairie County Park. Under the Waning Gibbous moon, conditions are perfect for a quiet night, with an overnight low of 52 degrees and no rain predicted.

The City of Verona Plan Commission is reviewing multiple development and site plans this week, including projects on Country View Court and South Main Street. Additionally, the city recently celebrated the success of several community initiatives like the sticker design contest and new senior center programs.

Today you can participate in yoga at Insight Wellness. Tomorrow brings plenty of trivia options at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, followed by the downtown farmer's market and live music later in the week.
On September 21, officers investigated a retail theft where an individual was identified and cited for taking Swedish Fish candy from a local store.
Today's flavor of the day is the Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently open but will be closing soon in 48 minutes, so stop by before they lock up for the night.
